generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must have experience in carrying out similar type of development work as contained in this tender i.e. Construction of Decline for an Underground mine, preferably in a gold mines.
The tenderer must have adequate skill, experience and facilities for executing the type of work herein contained and for which they shall be tendering.
Only such Tenderers who have performed the work as specified in the scheduled Scope of Work, as a principal Contractor or as partner of a Consortium will be eligible to participate in this Tender.

The Tenderer must be capable of satisfying the Company as to their technical competence to execute this work. A list of similar work undertaken with the quantity and value and delay (if any) shall be enclosed. The tenderer should also submit the performance certificate from the party where the job was undertaken about the technical competence and job undertaken in the last five years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25).

The tenderer must have adequate financial and commercial capability to undertake execution of a work of the type and magnitude as the work tendered and the documentary evidences in this regard shall be submitted in their techno-commercial offer.
Should have completed execution of similar type of work of atleast worth Rs. 8 Cr. in a 12 calendar months in any one of the last five financial years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25).

The bidder in any one of the last five financial years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) should have achieved in at least one Financial year, the turnover per annum not less than the Rs.7.50 Crore. The turnover certificate, to this effect, issued by the Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed.

The employees of the Company and their dependents/relatives are debarred from Offering the bids/submitting the tender either directly or indirectly. A declaration to this effect shall be submitted along with the offer.

Since the work is of urgent nature and important for Mine production, the successful bidder should start the work within 15days from the date of issue of work order/ Letter of Intent. An appointed committee may visit to verify the ready availability of equipment like LHD, Boomer/ Jumbo etc with the party. If the successful contractor is unable to start work within 15 days, the Work Order/ Letter of Intent will be withdrawn/ cancelled and the work will be awarded to the second lowest party and asked to match the rates with L1 party. A declaration shall be attached by the bidder in technical bid.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Copies of Profit & Loss statement, Balance Sheets for FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 shall be enclosed.
Company Registration Certificate
Copies of Income Tax Returns for each of the FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 to be submitted.
Detailed scheme for executing the work along with type and number of equipment, the Tenderer proposes to deploy as per Annexure-I.
Detailed Time Schedule consisting of every activity including preparatory works in sequential manner starting from the date of acceptance of the tender

Organization chart giving details of field management at site, the Tenderer proposes to have for this job. Total number of statutorily qualified persons e.g., Underground Manager, Mine Foreman, Mining Mate, Blasters along with qualified Engineers etc. going to be deployed by the Tenderer as per Annexure - II.
Details of work experience in respect of the type of job in the tendered pro-forma as per Annexure - III and performance certificate thereof including all the requirements asked in 1.4
Turn-over in mining contracts in FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 along with present commitments.

Solvency certificate from Nationalized/Schedule A Bank to prove financial ability to carry out the work tendered for and other details required in Annexure-IV to evaluate financial status of the Tenderer.
Type and number of equipment if any, with their value which he is likely to import at his cost on his own.
Monthly requirement of explosives, detonators per unit of excavation along with requirement of electricity in terms of KW /Hour

In the case of a Firm, Company or Corporation. i. The legal name, the nature of the business along with year of incorporation and full address of the registered office. ii. The authorized, subscribed and paid-up Capital wherever applicable. iii. The name and address of all the Directors, Chief Executives, Directors, President, Secretary, or other persons authorized to bind the firm, Company or Corporation.
The Tenderer should enclose certified copy of Valid PF registration number allocated by the PF authorities.
Tenders of Sick Companies and Companies referred to National Company Law Tribunal NCLT and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal NCLAT. will not be considered.
Tenders submitted by a party which is black listed by the Govt. agency will not be considered. Rejection in this regard can be done during course of tender also.
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
Copy of GST Registration Certificate
Copy of PAN Card
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of UG Decline & Development works

itemList.description:
Construction of Decline 5m (w) x3.5m (h) at a general gradient of 1 in 7
between existing decline and 2600 Level, with mechanized means using
Drill Jumbo, Low Profile Loader and other related Underground equipment
including blasting, muck removal and transportation to the bin / designated
location in Underground and dewatering. The excavation include Roof
bolting, wire mesh fixing, pipeline fixing, drainage concreting. Also includes
cable fixing, lights for illumination and providing adequate
ventilation.Dumping distance will be around 500m from starting point of
Decline.

Construction of Man hole of size 1.0m width x 1.8m height x1.2m depth, at
every 20 meter along the decline including drilling, blasting, disposal of
muck to Bin/ designated location in Underground. Excavation include Roof
bolting, wire mesh fixing.

Construction of cross cut from decline 5m (w) x3.5m (h) with mechanized
means using Drill Jumbo , Low Profile Loader and other related
Underground equipment including blasting, muck removal and
transportation to the bin / designated location in Underground and
dewatering. The excavation include Roof bolting, wire mesh fixing, pipeline
fixing, drainage concreting. Also includes cable fixing, lights for illumination
and providing adequate ventilation.

Handling water per day above rate of flow of 50Lpm including pump, its
installation, operation and maintenance.

Level Development of Drive/cross cut of 3m (w) x 3m (h) including blasting,
muck removal and transportation to the bin / designated location in
Underground. The excavation include Roof bolting,track line laying,
pipeline fixing, and providing adequate ventilation.

Level Development of Drive/cross cut of 4m (w) x 3.2m (h) including
blasting, muck removal and transportation to the bin / designated location
in Underground. The excavation include Roof bolting, wire mesh fixing,
pipeline fixing, track line laying and providing adequate ventilation.

Excavation, Drive widening to convert existing drive from 2.8m (w) x2.8m (h)
(approx.) to 4m (w) x 3.2m (h)& other Stripping Works with Jack Hammer
Drilling & blasting including muck removal transporting to bin or to a
designated location in underground. The excavation include Roof bolting,
wire mesh fixing, pipeline fixing, and providing adequate ventilation.
